explanation: Following an error-report entry puts focus parameters in the URL, which the app removes again by replacing the location; a navigation issued before that replace lands gets overwritten and the app stays put (the guard compares pathnames that an issued-but-uncommitted React Router navigation has not updated).
fix: Product bug tracked separately; the spec waits for the focus parameters to clear (`cy.location('search').should('not.contain', 'focusComponentId')`) before navigating.
